exposure: PPCM patients vs. control group (women who gave birth around the same time without organic disease)
outcome: Predictors of poor outcomes in PPCM patients
cohort: 44 women with PPCM and 79 women who gave birth around the same time as the PPCM patients and who did not have organic disease
finding: A risk score consisting of pericardial effusion, left ventricular dilatation, and d-dimer level ≥ 0.5 μg/mL could help streamline the diagnosis of PPCM prior to confirmatory investigations.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery with preterm labor was significantly higher in PPCM patients compared to the control group (31.8% vs. 17.7%, P = 0.037).
birth_weight: Neonates of PPCM patients had lower birth weight compared to the control group (2.70±0.66 kg vs. 3.21±0.57 kg, P<0.001).
